top_signals.title: FTSE 100 Live: Stocks gain as oil prices fall back towards $100
top_signals.summary: Welcome back to City AM’s FTSE 100 liveblog. The UK’s blue-chip index is set to make gains on Monday morning, according to futures from investment platform IG. This would see the FTSE 100 reverse some of the heavy losses it suffered on Friday, when the index closed 1.5 per cent lower. Falling oil prices pushed [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
